native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 1, 'state': {'rgb1': 'off', 'rgb2': 'off', 'sevseg1': '0'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After power-on or reset, the 7-segment display shows 0, and both RGB LEDs are off.'}

test2: {'time': 'after 6 clicks on btn1', 'state': {'rgb1': 'green', 'rgb2': 'yellow', 'sevseg1': '6'}, 'description': 'After 6 button presses (all on btn1), the count is 6. Since count is between 5 and 9, rgb1 displays green, rgb2 displays yellow, and the 7-segment display shows 6.'}

test3: {'time': 'after 6 additional clicks on btn2', 'state': {'rgb1': 'purple', 'rgb2': 'cyan', 'sevseg1': '12'}, 'description': 'After 12 total button presses (6 on btn1, 6 on btn2), the count is 12. Since count is 10 or greater, rgb1 displays purple, rgb2 displays cyan, and the 7-segment display shows the ones digit (2).'}

test4: {'time': 'after 4 additional clicks on btn3', 'state': {'rgb1': 'purple', 'rgb2': 'cyan', 'sevseg1': '0'}, 'description': 'After 16 total button presses (6 on btn1, 6 on btn2, 4 on btn3), the count exceeds 15 and resets to 0. rgb1 and rgb2 return to initial state (off), and the 7-segment display shows 0.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
